# Knowledge Graph

A knowledge graph connects notes through explicit links and inferred
similarity. Compare with plain [[Retrieval]], which ranks documents
without modeling relationships.

A wikilink like [[Retrieval#Ranking]] carries an anchor into a heading,
and [[Retrieval|the retrieval note]] shows an alias.
